node.statement: For any z, the product-norm and approximate-unit axioms in def-epsilon-cstar-algebra and ||J-I||<=epsilon_X give ||Jz-z|| <= ||(J-I)z||+||Iz-z|| <= ((1+epsilon_X)epsilon_X+epsilon_X)||z||=(2+epsilon_X)epsilon_X||z||, and likewise ||zJ-z|| <= (2+epsilon_X)epsilon_X||z||. Taking z=J also gives ||J-JJ|| <= (2+epsilon_X)epsilon_X because ||J||=1. Since ||phi||=1, the defining correction therefore satisfies ||x bold-dot y-xy|| <= 3(2+epsilon_X)epsilon_X||x||||y|| <= (15/2)epsilon_X||x||||y|| <= 8epsilon_X||x||||y||. Along with ||J-I_X||<=epsilon_X<=8epsilon_X, this proves the root with the universal choices e_unit=1/2 and C_unit=8.
